requiredFindings.area: Independent failure acquisition and durable terminal report
requiredFindings.observation: The finally block invokes summaryQuery=query and exportQuery=query outside guarded acquisition blocks. A child launch/communicate exception escapes finally before the peer query, original retention and final status/persist. The directory-copy loop also has one encompassing try, so one bad original prevents retention of later peers. If caffeinate launch raises after native launch, current exception path does not first establish native termination before export.
requiredFindings.consequence: Ordinary result-export/child/persistence errors can leave incomplete RUNNING evidence and skip available original peers. Existing parser/help/argument controls do not execute these actual-main paths.
requiredFindings.minimumCorrection: Use independently guarded summary/export/per-original acquisition with incremental raw/query/error/index retention and unconditional terminal failure persistence. Preserve available later peers after a per-entry fault. Ensure known launched native has bounded natural completion/fallback before acquisition if orchestration fails while it is active. Any error remains unaccepted; no blanket disk-failure guarantee.
requiredFindings.requiredControls: Actual-main injected summary launch/communicate, exporter launch/nonzero, malformed manifest, first-peer read/copy and terminal-persist failures plus a complete successful acquisition. Fake child/export endpoints explicit; real isolated file retention exercised; no native claim.

requiredFindings.area: Compiled pair/source/command evidence and mandatory checker
requiredFindings.observation: Driver verifies current app/test bytes prelaunch but stores only the build filename and input count, without exact acquired build/source/archive/app/test metadata. Mandatory checker verifies current source count/provider and trace/readback/export, but never reloads/verifies the build receipt/current pair or validates retained native command/destination/only-testing/result path against the selected case.
requiredFindings.consequence: The intended pair was checked by producer source, but a later independent accepted audit cannot itself bind the retained native trial to that exact compiled pair/command from saved facts. Current pure command-builder controls only choose checker case arguments.
requiredFindings.minimumCorrection: Retain exact prelaunch manifest/archive/build-receipt hashes and app/test path/size/hash observations with exact native argv. Mandatory checker revalidates actual recorded/current pair/source and expected dedicated device/case/result path. Bind actual installed app identity if runtime-installed identity is claimed. Require fresh source/build/receipt coherence and reject missing/null/spoofed/tampered metadata.
requiredFindings.requiredControls: Actual checker/caller metadata replay with genuine retained metadata and explicit byte/hash/path/build/source/device/testcase/argv negatives, without globally skipping metadata-null payloads or executing a native trial.

requiredFindings.observation: Driver first writes prefix+-original-manifest.json. Its unfiltered loop then visits manifest.json and computes prefix+-original-+file.name, the identical target, followed by assert not target.exists. Every normal exported manifest therefore causes complete-original-export error; later peers may be skipped depending on sorted names.
requiredFindings.minimumCorrection: Retain the original manifest once and inventory that exact already-retained file, or accept only byte-identical existing target explicitly. Preserve exact unfiltered manifest/inventory semantics and never silently omit it.
requiredFindings.requiredControls: Actual-main complete-success export including manifest plus PNG/JSON peers must succeed; explicit manifest collision/exact-reuse/mismatch and later-peer continuation negatives required.
